name: Mend Flesh
description: Closes what is open. Slow, ugly work that leaves a seam — and it will not set a bone or draw out rot.

name: Guttering Light
description: A cold flame that sits in the palm and casts about as far as a candle. It goes out when you are frightened.

name: Hush
description: Sound leaves a small space around you. Useful for a door, a lock, or a conversation that must not carry.

name: False Face
description: Your features slide a half-inch out of true. It does not make you someone else — only harder to swear to.

name: Read Echoes
description: The last strong feeling in a room repeats itself faintly. It tells you nothing about who, and it is frequently the wrong feeling.

name: Chill Touch
description: Draws the warmth out of what you are holding. It hurts more than it harms, which is often the point.

name: Chains of Earth
description: The ground takes an interest in someone's feet. Brief, and it will not hold anyone determined.

name: Borrowed Breath
description: You breathe for someone who has stopped. It buys minutes, not a life, and those minutes are taken from you.

name: Gravesong
description: A tune the dead attend to. They do not obey it; they merely stop pretending not to hear.
